items.problem: The Project File Updates section names explicit <Compile Include> items only as something to DROP, which can mislead an agent into thinking all such items (including linked shared sources) are irrelevant rather than something that must still be materialized.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md > Project File Updates previously said the UWP csproj's 'explicit <Compile Include=...> items ... none of which build under WinAppSDK' with no exception for <Link>ed out-of-cone sources.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md > Project File Updates > 'Do not copy the UWP .csproj over the scaffold's.'
items.proposed_improvement: Add an explicit callout that <Link>ed shared sources ARE materialized (now auto-harvested by the bootstrap) and must NOT be re-added as <Compile Include> on top of the default glob (duplicate-item errors). Sharpen the distinction between 'drop UWP-only csproj markers' and 'keep shared source content'.
items.generalizes: Any sample using shared content; clarifying prevents both the missing-types failure and a duplicate-item failure from over-correcting.
